field.name: com_tjucm_cyberassessment_FreetextOverview
field.label: Freetext:Overview
field.freetext:
This cyber assessment is intended to help you to prepare for Cyber Essentials, but is not a replacement for Cyber Essentials.  Not all of the questions are technical and they may require contacting other departments or staff members for the answers. It also contains some data protection questions for consideration in relation to computer systems.
The form can be saved and returned to for completion at any time.

Please note: The answers to some questions may cause other questions to appear to establish schedules and regularity of reviews.
Each answer gives further guidance to help with completion which may include links to the Data Protection Education Knowledge Bank or external sites such as the NCSC (National Cyber Security Centre).
Ideally all answers should have a 'Complete' to ensure cyber readiness.
Please start by choosing your organisation below:

field.name: com_tjucm_cyberassessment_FreetextGuidanceandLeadership
field.label: Freetext:Guidance and Leadership
field.freetext:
A cyber security strategy is a high-level plan for how your organisation will secure its data and information to combat cyber threats proactively.
An effective cyber security strategy focuses on threat prevention rather than threat detection.  By identifying different ways in which an organisation can be attacked, and closing the security gaps, the organisation can reduce the potential risk and cost of an attack to the organisation.
